note.question: How do consumers search for product information to resolve valuation uncertainties before purchase?
note.overview: Consumers search for product information to resolve valuation uncertainties before purchase. We incorporate search cost into consumer choice models and study the two-stage consider-then-choose policy. In the first stage, a consumer forms her consideration set by balancing utility uncertainty and search cost.
